question.text: The area bounded by the curve <math><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mo>=</mo><mfenced close="}" open="{" separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> with the <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></math>-axis from <math><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>=</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi></math> to <math><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3.8</mn></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mfrac><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></mrow></mfenced><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> sq. units, then the value of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi></math> is equal to (where <math><mfenced close="}" open="{" separators="|"><mrow><mo>.</mo></mrow></mfenced></math> denotes the fractional part function)

solution.text:
Required Area = Area of Trapezium
=12 (Sum of parallel sides) (Distance between them)
=12π+3.83.8-π
=12π-3+0.83.8-π
=12π-2.23.8-π
=π2-1.13.8-π sq. units
⇒b=3.8, a=1.1
